annotations.title: Find Where a Past Bug May Still Hide

description:
Finds past fixes of a kind of bug ("null run data guard", "prototype pollution",
"race condition on resume") in an imported repository, and the current files where the
same defect may still exist: files of the same kind next to the fixed ones, files that
usually change with them but were left out, and files that contain the identifiers the
fix changed. Read each candidate with the fix in mind; a candidate is not a confirmed bug.
name: hokmah_similar_fixes
title: Find Where a Past Bug May Still Hide
